metadata.case_name: HO FOR SANG v. LAU SUN CHOI & ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: had not worked since the accident

injuries.description: dislocation of the left second, third and fourth distal interphalangael joints of the toes
source: he suffered dislocation of the left second, third and fourth distal interphalangael joints of the toes with compound fracture of the left fifth metatarsal bones and fracture of the right second metatarsal bones.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

injuries.description: compound fracture of the left fifth metatarsal bones
source: he suffered dislocation of the left second, third and fourth distal interphalangael joints of the toes with compound fracture of the left fifth metatarsal bones and fracture of the right second metatarsal bones.

injuries.description: fracture of the right second metatarsal bones

injuries.description: crushing injury of his feet causing abnormalities to the bony and soft tissue structure of his forefeet
source: crushing injury of his feet causing abnormalities to the bony and soft tissue structure of his forefeet.
injuries.icd_description: Crushing injury of other parts of foot

manifestations.description: unconscious and admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital
ache and numbness on both feet
not able to stand or walk for longer than 30 minutes
had to rely on a stick to walk
walked with a limp dragging more heavily on his left foot, as his toes on the left foot were not able to touch the ground

treatments_received: treatment with a Chinese bonesetter (about 15 occasions)
use of crutches for about a year
treatments_future: orthopaedic shoes (recommended by Dr. Wu and Dr. Chun)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (award under this head $450,000)
Not able to stand or walk for longer than 30 minutes; relies on a stick; walks with a limp
Total loss of future earnings and inability to find suitable employment since the accident
